390.bodyText: STAMPLI VS. RAMP Stampli vs. Ramp The key differences between Stampli versus Ramp’s AP automation Ramp simply can’t handle anything more than basic AP needs. It’s an entry-level solution built by a credit card company that can only support basic AP processes. Without a deep understanding of AP, it’s no surprise that Ramp’s customers complain of ERP data conflicts that require constant manual repair. Stampli is different. Let's Talk Stampli vs. Ramp G2 Satisfaction Scores → 99 Stampli 76 Ramp Ease of Use 95% 94% Quality of Support 96% 91% Ease of Set Up 94% 94% Ease of Admin 94% 95% Ease of Doing Business With 96% 96% The G2 scores in this chart are from the AP Automation category officially released in December 2025. Companies big and small trust Stampli with $100 billion in AP spend...and counting Ramp’s AP automation is a credit-card add-on. Not a real solution. Stampli P2P is built for AP first Ramp is great at credit cards, but AP is new territory. Do you really want to be their guinea pig? Stampli’s AI reduces manual work Ramp is also new to AI for AP. Do you really want invoice coding and vendor onboarding to stay mostly manual? Stampli won’t disrupt your ERP data Ramp’s lack of integration experience manifests as ERP data conflicts. They overwrite your ERP’s vendor data instead of respecting it as the source of truth. Stampli adapts to how you want to run AP Ramp only offers fixed, predefined workflows. Your business will only grow more complex — do you really want your AP to be stuck? What should you ask Ramp about? If you’re comparing Stampli versus Ramp, here are a few questions you should ask Ramp. What is the level of flexibility in your approval workflows? Can we determine how we pay different vendors? How does your system handle growing invoice volumes? How do vendor communications work in your system? What do vendors have access to? Is there any manual work involved when processing invoices? How does vendor data sync between your system and our ERP? What does the implementation process look like? Stampli is built for the way YOU run AP Least disruption No need to rework the ERP or change your AP processes Ensure control & compliance Fully configurable and auditable payment workflows Most control One place for all your communication, documentation and workflows Smartest AI Billy operates across the entire invoice lifecycle Fastest to value Deploys in weeks, not months, with minimal user training What do Stampli customers appreciate most? “Stampli allows for us to more accurately project cash flow, which helps us provide drastically better financial guidance to our owners.” AMANDA BROWN Controller, Wenspok Companies “Many AP automation companies have started in the payments industry and gradually expanded to AP, but Stampli started in AP. I like that Stampli was AP first.” CURTIS ASH CFO, Avid Acceptance “Stampli was quickly integrated with our ERP and has enabled us to automate the entire invoice approval workflow.” RYAN MUSTAFA AP Accountant, Kiva “I’d say Stampli displaces $150K to $200K in labor expenses annually, while providing more accuracy and reducing human error.” ANTHONY FERNANDES Financial Controller, Alden Renewables “Stampli allows for us to more accurately project cash flow, which helps us provide drastically better financial guidance to our owners.” AMANDA BROWN Controller, Wenspok Companies “Many AP automation companies have started in the payments industry and gradually expanded to AP, but Stampli started in AP. I like that Stampli was AP first.” CURTIS ASH CFO, Avid Acceptance Skip the ramp. Own the runway. If your business is dead simple, Ramp will work. If that’s not you, connect with our team for a demo of Stampli based on your specific ERP environment.
